reviews.name: Isabelle Adler
reviews.text: The best ever, seriously!!! I have done multiple trips with SYB and the most recent was fantastic as ever. We had a great time in the Dolomites - hikes were challenging but doable. Then, Lake Garda was fabulous and so refreshing. Thank you to the leaders for doing a great job!

reviews.name: Kelly Balzereit
reviews.text:
I booked a very last minute trip to the Dolomites in September, and I can truly say it was one of the most incredible trips I’ve been on. From start to finish, everything was perfectly organized. The hikes, the views, the food, the energy…. all absolutely unforgettable.

Every single person on the trip brought such great energy. By the end of the trip, it felt like one big family. The trip leaders went above and beyond to make sure everyone was taken care of, motivated, and having the best time possible. They really set the tone for such a positive and fun environment.

The hikes through the Dolomites were breathtaking!! If you like hiking, this is the trip for you. Jaw-dropping scenery on every hike.

I’ve made lifelong friends on this trip. I already have several other trips planned with them. That alone says so much about the kind of community SYB builds.

If you’re even considering this trip, do it. It’s more than just a vacation - it’s a crazy experience with little sleep and a reminder of how good it feels to be surrounded by like-minded, adventurous people in an extraordinary place.

reviews.name: Lily McMahon
reviews.text:
I just returned from my second trip with SYB in the Dolomites and it was incredible! The breathtaking scenery and camaraderie created by our amazing trip leaders made the experience truly memorable. Each leader brought unique energy, fostering a true sense of community among like minded adventurers. We built lasting memories together, challenging ourselves and supporting one another along the way.
If you’re looking for an adventure that enriches your life and connects you with others, I can’t recommend SYB enough. Whether it’s the Dolomites or any of their other trips, you’re in for an unforgettable experience. I’d give it a solid 100 out of 10!
Book it and go! A huge shou out to Aaron, Eli, Lauren, Alex, and Cristina. Thank you SYB!

reviews.name: Jaclyn Marrinan
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about traveling with SYB! I did the Dolomites trip with Aaron, Lauren, Alex, Eli, and Cristina. The trip was well planned with amazing leaders and a great group of people. A great combination of yoga, exercise, hiking, good food, and fun. Would absolutely go again!

reviews.name: Gianna Cassio
reviews.text: Just got back from a trip to Italy and hiking the Dolomites + a boat day on Lake Garda! Hands down one of the best trips I've ever taken! Wild to think I didn't know the other 43 people going into this trip and now we are all good friends. Our guides Alex, Lauren, Eli, Aaron, and Christina were all fantastic! The hiking was incredible, the food was delicious, and the conversations warmed the soul. This was my first time to Europe and I want to travel more, but not quite solo yet, and this was a great way to do it. I'm already planning on booking my next one with them (Iceland 2.0)!  I highly recommend taking a trip with Surf Yoga Beer!

reviews.name: Ann Helenius
reviews.text: The Dolomites was my third trip with SYB. These amazing leaders and the group on this trip, took this breathtaking Dolomites experience to the next level! Meet likeminded people exploring epic views!

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Becca Valle
reviews.text:
Four trips in, and SYB still has me hooked 💎
The Dolomites gave me everything: breathtaking hikes, yoga with mountain backdrops, boat days, pasta dreams 🤌, and the best people turned friends. Honestly, why are you still reading this? DON’T THINK, JUST DO — book the adventure you’ll never forget 💫

reviews.name: Eli Hoffman
reviews.text: I just wrapped up my 2nd Surf Yoga Beer trip last week (Iceland, after previously doing Dolomites). As I reflect on the trip, I have such a feeling of gratitude to be able to experience such a cool destination with an amazing group of people. The group leaders (Bradford, Eli and Bri) did an amazing job organizing the trip, adapting to weather conditions, and making everyone feel welcome. SYB attracts a really special group of people. While the ages range from mid-20s to mid-40s, everyone shares a sense of adventure, a willingness to go with the flow, and an optimism about what new site, party, or surprise might be right around the corner. While my memory of the trip will definitely involve mountains and lagoons, it will also center on the great conversations while hiking, hanging in hot springs, or sweating in a sauna. I come away from the trip feeling both old and young all at once and looking forward to my next adventure! I highly recommend SYB for your next trip!

reviews.name: Andrea Horowitz
reviews.text:
I just returned from my first trip with Surf Yoga Beer, and I can’t stop raving about it! Our adventure in the stunning Dolomites was nothing short of incredible. The breathtaking hikes through picturesque landscapes were incredible, but the people really made the trip.

Mantas and the team have truly created something remarkable with Surf Yoga Beer, and I’m already looking forward to my next adventure with them (once you’re IN, you’re IN!) A huge shoutout to our fantastic trip leader, Juliana, and our hiking expert, Aaron! They both brought so much incredible high-vibe energy and expertise and the trip wouldn't have been the same without them!

In case you're curious about group dynamics, we had a vibrant group of 40 people, ages 26-45, and I can honestly say everyone was fantastic. The group was so fun, welcoming, and I left with a whole crew of new friends!

If you’re on the fence about signing up for Surf Yoga Beer, just do it! I promise you won’t regret it.
